description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'EnforcedThingMapperTest' that verifies the mapping of a JSON representation of a 'thing' to a MongoDB Document with enforced policies and permissions. It focuses on testing the 'mapThing' method in the 'EnforcedThingMapper' class to ensure correct transformation under policy enforcement conditions.

classes.name: EnforcedThingMapperTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the mapping of a 'thing' JSON object to a MongoDB Document with policy enforcement.

methods.name: testV2Thing
methods.description: Test method that creates a sample 'thing' JSON object, applies policy enforcers, maps it to a Document, and asserts correct mapping.
